stem: Which situation violates the Eighth Amendment protections regarding criminal punishment?

options.label: A
options.text: A protester is jailed for violent acts at a political rally.

options.label: B
options.text: A person is sentenced to life in prison for shoplifting.

options.label: C
options.text: A person is sentenced to ten years imprisonment for assault and robbery.

options.label: D
options.text: A judge orders that an accused person be jailed until bail is paid.
